name: Prayer Forecourt
summary: A tall corner minaret anchors a compact hall, while a prayer rug extends naturally from its open doorway.
why: The hall, tower and rug share the same two axonometric axes. The rug center v=10 meets the doorway center v=10 exactly. The doorway has four units of solid wall above its apex. Every tower stage touches the stage beneath it.
risk: At the smallest size the rug reads as a welcoming terrace. The direct doorway connection carries its intention without tassels or small fabric details.
reasonToChoose: You want an architectural mosque identity with visible depth and a distinct courtyard silhouette.
